notes.title: TPOT Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello fellow Tersians!

We've just released our next patch.

TPOT Patch 1.0.4 consists of..
[list]
[*] Quality of Life and fixes for Flute Puzzle.
[*] Dark Red Reed is now a Light Violet Colour.
[*] The music in the background of the Flute Puzzle has been toned down for clearer hearing.
[*] The Reeds will now make the pitch sound effect when the player interacts with them.
[/list]

Thank you everyone for your continued support.
We hope you're enjoying Tersa as much as us!

-Madorium

notes.title: TPOT Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello fellow Tersians!

We've just put out our first patch for TPOT:ACP.

Thank you to everyone for the feedback!
And we apologise for bugs found.

[b]TPOT Patch 1.0.1 consists of..[/b]
[list]
[*] Quality of Life fixes for flute puzzle.
[*] Quality of Life fixes in the Forest.
[*] Fix for flute puzzle that caused the cursor to go invisible and lock users out of game.
[*] Fixed a number of instances where Cynthia or Tippo would face incorrect direction in conversations.
[*] Fixed scenario that would cause Vegetender conversations to lock users in the conversation.
[*] Added version number to settings in main menu.
[*] Hotfix to fix unworking Steam Achievements.
[/list]

We hope you all continue to enjoy Tersa.

-Madorium

notes.title: A Curious Place to Release March 28!
notes.content:
Exciting news everyone. We will be releasing The Puppet of Tersa: A Curious Place on the 28th of March!

If you haven't added us to your wishlist yet, now is the time! Those who buy during launch will enjoy a 40% discount off our normal $9.99 price.

We're so very excited to share all of our hard work with you, and can't wait for everyone to play!

Thank you for your support,

x Madorium

notes.title: PC Demo Version 0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We have pushed a small but mighty update to our demo this morning. Here are the patch notes:

- The Puppet of Tersa demo is now playable on 32-bit Windows systems!
- Our inventory control system has been reworked. Previously items would be drag and drop to combine/use, you can now left-click once to select and left-click again to combine/use. Right-click allows you to examine the item.
- A few text updates are live (namely some interactions have been altered/added in)
- Bucket puzzle has been updated 


Thank you so much for giving our demo a play, we hope you enjoy it!

Don't forget to connect with us here on Steam, [url=http://www.twitter.com/puppetoftersa]Twitter[/url], [url=http://www.facebook.com/puppetoftersa]Facebook[/url], [url=http://www.instagram.com/madorium]Instagram[/url], [url=http://www.reddit.com/r/thepuppetoftersa]Reddit[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/4Fuja4N]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Demo is LIVE!
notes.content:
We are extremely excited to announce that our demo is available now! 

Within it are three different areas that will allow you to interact with creatures, the environment, and even one of our handcrafted puzzles. This demo is intended to give you a small taste of what’s to come throughout the rest of [i]The Puppet of Tersa[/i]. Meet Cynthia, Tippo, and one other unique character as you start your journey through the land of Tersa!

Please feel free to share any thoughts, feedback, or excitement you have related to the demo with us here on Steam, [url=www.twitter.com/puppetoftersa]Twitter[/url], [url=www.facebook.com/puppetoftersa]Facebook[/url], [url=www.reddit.com/r/thepuppetoftersa]Reddit[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/p8CQ6Kx]Discord[/url]!

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for playing and we hope you enjoy it!

x Madorium

EDIT: It has come to our attention that the demo is only playing for Windows systems running at 64-bit. We are working to find a solution.

notes.title: New to Steam & [Demo] Incoming!
notes.content:
Hello Steam!

[url=https://medium.com/@madorium/we-are-madorium-eb9b7b3be5ea]We are Madorium[/url], and this is our in-development fantastical point-and-click adventure game, The Puppet of Tersa. 

Welcome fans old and new!

We are extremely excited to announce that along with this launch of our Steam page, we will be releasing a demo! This upcoming free demo will allow you to play through the first three areas of The Puppet of Tersa: A Curious Place. Please watch here and any of our socials for an update when the demo launches. We look forward to hearing all of your comments, praise, and feedback! 

If you have any interest in sharing your favorite moments please tag us on Facebook ([url=https://www.facebook.com/PuppetofTersa/]Puppet of Tersa[/url]), Twitter ([url=https://twitter.com/PuppetofTersa]@puppetoftersa[/url]), or even Instagram ([url=https://www.instagram.com/madorium/]@Madorium[/url])!

Thank you for reading, and we look forward to connecting with all of you.
